scores.notes: Jesus stands in the boat with his arm stretched over the water while about eight disciples look up at him; the sea is settling toward a moonlit horizon. No marks, paint runs to every edge, hands and faces sound.

A milestone at right centre carries painted capitals reading 'RONAN / AILETE' (real letters, garbled words). Otherwise the scene fits: Saul kneeling and shielding his eyes under light from the sky, companions recoiling, walled Damascus behind (domes and a minaret are anachronistic).
Jesus cries out and points at the rock tomb before a reacting crowd while the wrapped Lazarus steps from the opening. No lettering, full-bleed paint, hands and faces sound.
Light breaks through dark cloud over a dark sea and rocks, with no figure of any kind. Small bare-paper patches along the left edge and a pale top-right corner (accepted for this item).

Lettering: rows of squiggle text on the desk papers and on a note pinned by the mantel, none readable. Rule: Holmes is styled with tousled modern curls and a long dark coat with upturned collar and scarf, the costume of the modern television adaptation rather than the period (I name no real person from the face); a panel radiator sits under the window and the open box holds several more blue stones.
Samuel pours oil from a horn over the kneeling David with Jesse and six brothers standing round, rays of light falling from the sky. No lettering, paint to all edges, hands sound.

Hezekiah in a blue gold-trimmed robe stands in the temple court while workers carry sacks to the storerooms beside a bronze basin on oxen; door panels carry winged-figure reliefs, not writing. Pale top-left is painted cloud, not bare canvas.
Peter, clutching his coat, dives from the boat toward the shore where Jesus stands by a fire; one disciple points and others haul the net of fish. No lettering, pale sky is painted, limbs sound.

Israelites with bundles, children and cattle walk the dry seabed between two towering walls of water, Moses with his staff at the front. Bare white paper at the bottom-right corner and ragged wash edges (accepted); no divine figure.
Job sits on an ash heap among potsherds looking up at a huge whirlwind, four companions behind him hiding their faces; God is shown only as the storm. No lettering, full-bleed paint.

The Levite kneels with a knife laid at the collar of the dead woman, who lies clothed on a mat, the donkey visible through the door; restrained, no blood. No lettering, painted to every edge, hands sound.

Jesus lies on a striped cushion in the stern as a disciple shakes him awake and four others bail and hold the sail in heavy waves. Cream paper shows along the left edge and top-left corner (accepted); hands sound.

Lettering: the nine dice on the flat stone are drawn as ringed tokens with small glyph-like pip marks, none readable (counted on the same footing as card pips). Soldiers cast lots over the folded garments below the cross; bare paper at both bottom corners and side edges (accepted).

March Hare, Hatter and the sleeping Dormouse crowd one corner of a long laid table while an indignant Alice sits in a large armchair at the far end, house and tree behind. White paper along the left edge and three corners (accepted); no lettering.
Saul staggers and falls in a shaft of light from the clouds, eight companions shielding their eyes, Damascus and palms beyond. No lettering, fresco-like paint reaches all edges, limbs sound.

Daniel watches flaming thrones and burning wheels set in the sky around a central blaze of white light, a vast multitude standing below; the Ancient of Days is light only, with no face, body or robe. No lettering, full-bleed paint.

Lettering: columns of pseudo-print on the scattered newspapers and two small wall plaques with blurred pseudo-text, none readable. Holmes tosses the ball of papers up to the rack while Watson sits opposite in the carriage; hands sound.

Lettering: a red heart pip on the playing card behind the King's back, with heart pips on his tunic; no readable text. The King shelters behind Alice before the floating Cat's head while the Queen walks off; pale bare paper at the top-left corner (accepted).
A man kneels with a knife beside the shrouded body of the woman on straw in a stone house; no wound or blood shown. White paper along both sides and the right corners (accepted); no lettering.

Lettering: the Hatter's large pocket watch has legible dial numerals (12, 1, 3, 9, 10), and a 4-like mark sits on a hat patch. Alice leans toward the Dormouse on the table while the Hare and an indignant Hatter hold cups; top-right corner is bare white paper (accepted).

Daniel raises a refusing palm and points to the blank wall before the enthroned king, courtiers and banquet tables with gold cups. The wall carries no writing and the frieze is rosettes only; full-bleed paint, hands sound.
Moses on a rock stretches his hand and staff over a storm-driven sea with wind-bent palms, the people and their animals gathered on the shore. No lettering, painted to the edges, no divine figure.

Lettering: a sheet pinned to the bookcase and loose papers carry rows of squiggle script, none readable. The masked giant in blue cloak with flame lining, astrakhan bands and fur-topped boots stands in the doorway before Holmes and the seated Watson; he holds a leather bag where the text gives a hat, and a modern-looking switch plate is on the right wall.

A large bearded man in a brown cloak with a staff stands in the right foreground watching, a narrator the verse does not call for. The empty throne is radiance only, with the four eyed and winged creatures, crowned elders, rainbow and glass floor; no lettering, paint to all edges.

Lettering: the station-master holds a printed sheet with a blocky pseudo-letter heading and a grid of marks, plus a cap badge, too small and garbled to read. The train stands at the station with a black smoke column behind the trees; right side and corners fade to bare white paper (accepted).

Moses strikes the rock with his staff and water pours into a pool where people, sheep, goats and camels drink, Aaron beside him. White unpainted paper along the top and all corners (accepted); no lettering.

Lettering: faint lines of pseudo-script on the papers on the desk and tick marks on the mantel clock dial, none readable. Holmes sits alone by the fire with steepled fingers among chemical glassware and a lens; hands sound.
A flaming wheeled throne holds a column of white light with no face, limbs or robe, ranks of white-clad attendants standing before it and Daniel watching at right. No lettering, full-bleed paint.

Alice leans in with a raised finger across the long laid table, the Hatter wide-eyed with cup and bread and the March Hare in coat and hat with the teapot, tree and house behind. No lettering, oil paint to every edge, hands sound.
Job sits alone on an ash heap among potsherds, staff in hand, looking up at a towering whirlwind with a walled city beyond; God is the storm only. No lettering, full-bleed paint.

Four soldiers kneel over the garments throwing two tiny dice (specks only, no discernible marks) below three crosses, the board above the central cross left blank. No lettering, restrained wounds, paint to all edges.

The crucified man at top right still wears a full belted tunic and blue mantle while the soldiers below divide his clothing, so the garments are both on him and on the ground. Otherwise four soldiers sort cloths and drop lots; no lettering, full-bleed paint.
Egyptian chariots and horsemen charge along the rutted seabed between two towering walls of water. No lettering, painted to the edges, horses and riders sound; no divine figure.

The father gestures to servants who bring an ornate robe, a ring and sandals to the ragged barefoot son in a village yard. Sky and top corners are left as bare white paper (accepted); no lettering, hands sound.

Lettering: heart, club and spade pips with tiny corner index marks on the background card soldiers, none readable. Rule: of those card figures only one is a flat oblong card; the others, including the man bent over as a hoop, are ordinary human bodies in pip tabards. Top-right corner and sides are bare paper (accepted).

Hatherley, both hands bandaged, points at the blazing white house with three horse-drawn fire-engines, a crowd, gravel drive and rose bushes, Holmes and Watson beside him. Ragged bare paper at the bottom-right corner (accepted); no lettering.

A small pale disembodied bearded face is embedded in a sooty patch of the vault brickwork above the crates at upper right. Otherwise the four men are placed as told: Watson crouched with his revolver on a crate, Holmes with the lantern, the bulky and the thin man behind; no lettering.

A bearded teacher in a dark mantle with blank scrolls addresses seated men and women at a stone table in a Greek town below an acropolis, showing the letter being delivered rather than the mirror image itself. No lettering, full-bleed paint, hands sound.

Daniel raises a refusing palm and points toward a stark blank white panel on the wall before the enthroned king and attendants; the panel carries no writing and the tapestry marks are ornament. Paint reaches all four edges, hands sound.

Peter steps from the boat onto the waves reaching toward Jesus, who stands on the water with his hand out, the other disciples watching from the boat under a storm sky. No lettering, full-bleed paint, hands and feet sound.

Lettering: the label on the bottle Alice is examining carries faint rows of squiggle lines, not readable. She stands by the glass three-legged table with the gold key, the curtain and low door behind and the hall of doors beyond; painted to the edges, hands sound.
